titles.english: Eleison Imas and Je Nai Nan

lines.coptic: Ϫⲉ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ Ⲫ̀ϯ Ⲫ̀ⲓⲱⲧ Ⲡⲓⲡⲁⲛⲧⲟⲕⲣⲁⲧⲱⲣ.

translations.english: Have mercy upon us O God, the Father, the Pantocrator.
translations.arabic: إرحمنا يا الله الآب ضابط الكل.

transliterations.english: Je nai nan Efnoti Efiot Pipantokrator.

translations.english: Have mercy upon us O God our Savior.

lines.coptic: Ϫⲉ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ Ⲫ̀ϯ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ.

translations.english: Have mercy upon us O God and have mercy.

transliterations.english: Je nai nan Efnoti o-woh nai nan.

lines.coptic: Ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ ⲏ̀ⲙⲁⲥ ⲟ̀ Ⲑⲉⲟⲥ ⲟ̀ Ⲡⲁⲧⲏⲣ ⲟ̀ Ⲡⲁⲛⲧⲟⲕⲣⲁⲧⲱⲣ.

transliterations.english: Ele-eeson eemas o Theos o Pateer o Pantokrator.

lines.coptic: Ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ ⲏ̀ⲙⲁⲥ ⲟ̀ Ⲑⲉⲟⲥ ⲟ̀ Ⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ.

transliterations.english: Ele-eeson eemas o Theos o Soteer eemon.

lines.coptic: Ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ ⲏ̀ⲙⲁⲥ ⲟ̀ Ⲑⲉⲟⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ ⲏ̀ⲙⲁⲥ.

transliterations.english: Ele-eeson eemas o Theos ke ele-eeson eemas.
